title: I built a complete Steam demo using AI, where does it still fall short?
author: beelllllll
selftext:
I’ve been experimenting with how far AI game development can be pushed, and I finally reached the point where **For The Realm** has a playable Steam demo.

Everything in the game was created using AI tools. The 3D models and other assets came from various third-party tools, while most of the code was written with Opus 4.8. I’m currently using Astra and Fable for polishing, bug fixes, and the final touches. I still handled the direction, game design, testing, and a lot of iteration.

The game itself is a highly cooperative deck-builder, but I’m mainly posting here because I’d love feedback from other AI developers. Does it feel like a cohesive game rather than an AI tech demo? Where does the AI-generated nature feel most obvious? And, most importantly, is it actually fun? Too much ai slop feel?

Honest and critical feedback would be extremely helpful:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040260/For\_The\_Realm/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040260/For_The_Realm/)

I look forward to your honest feedback!
